name: TMDB Metadata
description: Looks up movie/TV metadata (poster, description, cast) from TheMovieDB for the TITLES tab's MATCH button. Requires a free TMDB API key (this plugin's SETTINGS on the PLUGINS page).

tmdb:search.error: The TMDB Metadata plugin is disabled or missing (PLUGINS tab).

ipc.why: looks up a title's metadata for the TITLES tab's MATCH TMDB button
fetches cast info for a matched title

internet.why: searches TheMovieDB for a title's synopsis, poster and cast when you press MATCH
